description.value: Giant Victoria is an authorized Giant dealer situated in downtown Victoria, carrying the full Giant lineup of road, mountain, gravel, electric, and kids bikes alongside a broad accessories range. The shop is staffed by professional mechanics who focus exclusively on Giant, Liv, and Momentum brand bicycles. Touring cyclists will find a solid selection of rack, fender, lighting, and luggage options even if mechanical service requires advance booking.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates OSM contact data (address, phone, website) and confirms this is a staffed, active authorized Giant dealer. The service subpage explicitly states 'All services require an appointment' with a 1-3 week lead time and that the shop exclusively services Giant, Liv, and Momentum brand bikes, ruling out walk-in and same-day repairs for touring cyclists on other brands. OSM carries service:bicycle:pump=no, and the website's gear catalog confirms touring-relevant accessories (panniers, racks, fenders); the shop's full electric bike lineup and e-bike component listings confirm e-bike service capability.
concerns: Mechanical service is limited exclusively to Giant, Liv, and Momentum brand bikes — touring cyclists on other brands cannot get repairs here.
All services require an appointment with a current 1-3 week lead time, making this shop unsuitable for urgent on-tour repairs.
No public pump available (confirmed by OSM service:bicycle:pump=no).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, active authorized Giant dealer in downtown Victoria with a comprehensive parts and accessories inventory; valuable to touring cyclists for gear purchases and parts even though mechanical service is appointment-only and restricted to Giant, Liv, and Momentum brand bikes.

Pump available.detail: No website content mentions a public or customer-accessible pump

Same-day urgent repairs.detail: Service page states 'We are currently looking at a 1-3-week lead time for appointments.'

Touring parts stocked.detail: Bike Gear accessories section lists Bags & Panniers, Fenders, Racks, Lights, and Locks

E-bike service.detail: Shop services Giant, Liv, and Momentum bikes; Giant's serviced lineup includes Electric Road, Electric Mountain, Electric City, and Electric Adventure models; 'E-bike gear' is also listed as a components category

wow_evidence: All services require an appointment… exclusively services Giant, Liv, and Momentum brand bikes
